hasContentValue;\n    }\n\n    private eventToJson(ev: MatrixEvent): IEventWithRoomId {\n        const e = ev.getEffectiveEvent() as any;\n\n        if (ev.isEncrypted()) {\n            // Let us store some additional data so we can re-verify the event.\n            // The js-sdk checks if an event is encrypted using the algorithm,\n            // the sender key and ed25519 signing key are signing.\n            e.curve25519Key = ev.getSenderKey();\n            e.ed25519Key = ev.getClaimedEd25519Key();\n            e.algorithm = ev.getWireContent().algorithm;\n            e.forwardingCurve25519KeyChain = ev.getForwardingCurve25519KeyChain();\n        } else {\n            // Make sure that unencrypted events don't contain any of that data,\n            // despite what the server might give to us.\n            delete e.curve25519Key;\n            delete e.ed25519Key;\n            delete e.algorithm;\n            delete e.forwardingCurve25519KeyChain;\n        }\n\n        return e;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Queue up live events to be added to the event index.\n     *\n     * @param {MatrixEvent} ev The event that should be added to the index.\n     */\n    private async addLiveEventToIndex(ev: MatrixEvent): Promise<void> {\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n\n        if (!indexManager || !this.isValidEvent(ev)) return;\n\n        const e = this.eventToJson(ev);\n\n        const profile = {\n            displayname: ev.sender?.rawDisplayName,\n            avatar_url: ev.sender?.getMxcAvatarUrl(),\n        };\n\n        await indexManager.addEventToIndex(e, profile);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Emmit that the crawler has changed the checkpoint that it's currently\n     * handling.\n     */\n    private emitNewCheckpoint(): void {\n        this.emit(\"changedCheckpoint\", this.currentRoom());\n    }\n\n    private async addEventsFromLiveTimeline(timeline: EventTimeline): Promise<void> {\n        const events = timeline.getEvents();\n\n        for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {\n            const ev = events[i];\n            await this.addLiveEventToIndex(ev);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private async addRoomCheckpoint(roomId: string, fullCrawl = false): Promise<void> {\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        if (!indexManager) return;\n        const client = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        const room = client.getRoom(roomId);\n\n        if (!room) return;\n\n        const timeline = room.getLiveTimeline();\n        const token = timeline.getPaginationToken(Direction.Backward);\n\n        if (!token) {\n            // The room doesn't contain any tokens, meaning the live timeline\n            // contains all the events, add those to the index.\n            await this.addEventsFromLiveTimeline(timeline);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const checkpoint = {\n            roomId: room.roomId,\n            token: token,\n            fullCrawl: fullCrawl,\n            direction: Direction.Backward,\n        };\n\n        this.logger.debug(\"Adding checkpoint\", JSON.stringify(checkpoint));\n\n        try {\n            await indexManager.addCrawlerCheckpoint(checkpoint);\n        } catch (e) {\n            this.logger.warn(`Error adding new checkpoint for room ${room.roomId}`, e);\n        }\n\n        this.crawlerCheckpoints.push(checkpoint);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * The main crawler loop.\n     *\n     * Goes through crawlerCheckpoints and fetches events from the server to be\n     * added to the EventIndex.\n     *\n     * If a /room/{roomId}/messages request doesn't contain any events, stop the\n     * crawl, otherwise create a new checkpoint and push it to the\n     * crawlerCheckpoints queue, so we go through them in a round-robin way.\n     */\n    private async crawlerFunc(): Promise<void> {\n        let cancelled = false;\n\n        const client = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        if (!indexManager) return;\n\n        this.crawler = {\n            cancel: () => {\n                cancelled = true;\n            },\n        };\n\n        let idle = false;\n\n        while (!cancelled) {\n            let sleepTime = SettingsStore.getValueAt(SettingLevel.DEVICE, \"crawlerSleepTime\");\n\n            // Don't let the user configure a lower sleep time than 100 ms.\n            sleepTime = Math.max(sleepTime, 100);\n\n            if (idle) {\n                sleepTime = CRAWLER_IDLE_TIME;\n            }\n\n            if (this.currentCheckpoint !== null) {\n                this.currentCheckpoint = null;\n                this.emitNewCheckpoint();\n            }\n\n            await sleep(sleepTime);\n\n            if (cancelled) {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            const checkpoint = this.crawlerCheckpoints.shift();\n\n            /// There is no checkpoint available currently, one may appear if\n            // a sync with limited room timelines happens, so go back to sleep.\n            if (checkpoint === undefined) {\n                idle = true;\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            this.logger.debug(`Processing checkpoint ${JSON.stringify(checkpoint)}`);\n            this.currentCheckpoint = checkpoint;\n            this.emitNewCheckpoint();\n\n            idle = false;\n\n            // We have a checkpoint, let us fetch some messages, again, very\n            // conservatively to not bother our homeserver too much.\n            const eventMapper = client.getEventMapper({ preventReEmit: true });\n            // TODO we need to ensure to use member lazy loading with this\n            // request so we get the correct profiles.\n            let res: Awaited<ReturnType<MatrixClient[\"createMessagesRequest\"]>>;\n\n            try {\n                res = await client.createMessagesRequest(\n                    checkpoint.roomId,\n                    checkpoint.token,\n                    EVENTS_PER_CRAWL,\n                    checkpoint.direction,\n                );\n            } catch (e) {\n                if (e instanceof HTTPError && e.httpStatus === 403) {\n                    this.logger.debug(\n                        \"Removing checkpoint as we don't have \",\n indexManager.removeCrawlerCheckpoint(checkpoint);\n                    } catch (e) {\n                        this.logger.warn(`Error removing checkpoint ${JSON.stringify(checkpoint)}:`, e);\n But let us\n                        // ignore it for now as we don't want to hammer the\n                        // endpoint.\n                    }\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                this.logger.warn(`Error crawling using checkpoint ${JSON.stringify(checkpoint)}:`, e);\n                this.crawlerCheckpoints.push(checkpoint);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if (cancelled) {\n                this.crawlerCheckpoints.push(checkpoint);\n                break;\n            }\n\n            if (res.chunk.length === 0) {\n                this.logger.debug(\"Done with the checkpoint\", JSON.stringify(checkpoint));\n                // We got to the start/end of our timeline, lets just\n                // delete our checkpoint and go back to sleep.\n                try {\n                    await indexManager.removeCrawlerCheckpoint(checkpoint);\n                } catch (e) {\n                    this.logger.warn(\"Error removing checkpoint\", JSON.stringify(checkpoint), e);\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Convert the plain JSON events into Matrix events so they get\n            // decrypted if necessary.\n            const matrixEvents = res.chunk.map(eventMapper);\n            let stateEvents: MatrixEvent[] = [];\n            if (res.state !== undefined) {\n                stateEvents = res.state.map(eventMapper);\n            }\n\n            const profiles: Record<string, IMatrixProfile> = {};\n\n            stateEvents.forEach((ev) => {\n                if (ev.getContent().membership === KnownMembership.Join) {\n                    profiles[ev.getSender()!] = {\n                        displayname: ev.getContent().displayname,\n                        avatar_url: ev.getContent().avatar_url,\n                    };\n                }\n            });\n\n            const decryptionPromises = matrixEvents\n                .filter((event) => events to get decrypted.\n            await Promise.all(decryptionPromises);\n\n            // TODO if there are no events at this point we're missing a lot\n            // decryption keys, do we want to retry this checkpoint at a later\n            // stage?\n            const filteredEvents = matrixEvents.filter(this.isValidEvent);\n\n            // Collect the redaction events, so we can delete the redacted events from the index.\n            const redactionEvents = matrixEvents.filter((ev) => ev.isRedaction());\n\n            // Let us convert the events back into a format that EventIndex can\n            // consume.\n            const events = filteredEvents.map((ev) => {\n                const e = this.eventToJson(ev);\n\n                let profile: IMatrixProfile = {};\n                if (e.sender in profiles) profile = profiles[e.sender];\n                const object = {\n                    event: e,\n                    profile: profile,\n                };\n                return object;\n            });\n\n            let newCheckpoint: ICrawlerCheckpoint | null = null;\n\n            // The token can be null for some reason. Don't create a checkpoint\n            // in that case since adding it to the db will fail.\n            if (res.end) {\n                // Create a new checkpoint so we can continue crawling the this.crawlerCheckpoints.push(checkpoint);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Start the crawler background task.\n     */\n    public startCrawler(): void {\n        if (this.crawler search(searchArgs: ISearchArgs): Promise<IResultRoomEvents | undefined> {\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        return indexManager?.searchEventIndex(searchArgs);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Load events that contain URLs from the event index.\n     *\n     * @param {Room} room The room for which we should fetch events This is only needed if we're continuing to fill\n     * the timeline, e.g. if we're paginating. Use the\n            // disambiguated form always instead.\n            member.name = e.profile.displayname + \" (\" + matrixEvent.getSender() + \")\";\n\n            // This is sets the avatar URL.\n            const memberEvent = eventMapper({\n                content: {\n                    membership: KnownMembership.Join,\n                    avatar_url: e.profile.avatar_url,\n                    displayname: e.profile.displayname,\n                },\n                type: EventType.RoomMember,\n                event_id: matrixEvent.getId() + \":eventIndex\",\n                room_id: matrixEvent.getRoomId(),\n                sender: matrixEvent.getSender(),\n                origin_server_ts: matrixEvent.getTs(),\n                state_key: matrixEvent.getSender(),\n            });\n\n            // We set this manually to avoid emitting RoomMember.membership and\n            // RoomMember.name events.\n            member.events.member = memberEvent;\n            matrixEvent.sender = member;\n\n            return matrixEvent;\n        });\n\n        return matrixEvents;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Fill a timeline with events that contain URLs.\n     *\n     * @param {TimelineSet} timelineSet The TimelineSet the Timeline belongs to,\n     * used to check if we're adding duplicate events.\n     *\n     * @param {Timeline} timeline The Timeline which should be filed with\n     * events.\n     *\n     * @param {Room} room The room for which we should fetch events containing\n     * URLs\n     *\n     * @param {number} limit The maximum number of events to fetch.\n     *\n     * @param {string} fromEvent From which event should we continue fetching\n     * events from the index. (!timelineSet.eventIdToTimeline(e.getId()!)) {\n                timelineSet.addEventToTimeline(e, timeline, {\n                    toStartOfTimeline: direction == EventTimeline.BACKWARDS,\n                    fromCache: false,\n                    addToState: false,\n                });\n            }\n        });\n\n        let ret = false;\n        let paginationToken = \"\";\n\n        // Set the pagination token to the oldest event that we retrieved.\n        if (matrixEvents.length > 0) {\n            paginationToken = matrixEvents[matrixEvents.length - 1].getId()!;\n            ret = true;\n        }\n\n        this.logger.debug(\n            `Populating file panel with ${matrixEvents.length} events and setting the pagination token to ${paginationToken}`,\n        );\n\n        timeline.setPaginationToken(paginationToken, EventTimeline.BACKWARDS);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Emulate a TimelineWindow pagination() request with the event index as the event        return ret;\n        };\n\n        const paginationPromise = paginationMethod(timelineWindow, tl, room, direction, limit);\n        tl.pendingPaginate = paginationPromise;\n\n        return */\n    public async getStats(): Promise<IIndexStats | undefined> {\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        return indexManager?.getStats();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check if the room with the given id is already indexed.\n     *\n     * @param {string} roomId The ID of the room which we want to check if it\n     * has been already indexed.\n     *\n currently crawling.\n     *\n     * @returns {Room} A MatrixRoom that is being currently crawled, null\n     * if no room is currently being crawled.\n     */\n    public currentRoom(): Room | null (this.currentCheckpoint !== null) {\n            return client.getRoom(this.currentCheckpoint.roomId);\n        } else {\n            return client.getRoom(this.crawlerCheckpoints[0].roomId);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public crawlingRooms(): {\n        /** The rooms that we are currently crawling. */\n        crawlingRooms: Set<string>;\n\n        /** All the encrypted rooms known by the crawlingRooms.add(this.currentCheckpoint.roomId);\n        }\n\n        const client = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        const rooms = client.getRooms();\n\n        const isRoomEncrypted = (room: Room): boolean => {\n            return client.isRoomEncrypted(room.roomId);\n        };\n\n        const encryptedRooms = rooms.filter(isRoomEncrypted);\n        encryptedRooms.forEach((room, index) => {\n            totalRooms.add(room.roomId);\n        });\n\n        return { crawlingRooms, totalRooms };\n    }\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2019-2021 The Matrix.org holding the global EventIndex object. Can only be initialized if the\n * platform supports event indexing.\n */\n\nimport { logger } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/logger\";\n\nimport PlatformPeg from \"../PlatformPeg\";\nimport EventIndex from \"../indexing/EventIndex\";\nimport { MatrixClientPeg } from \"../MatrixClientPeg\";\nimport SettingsStore from \"../settings/SettingsStore\";\nimport { SettingLevel } from \"../settings/SettingLevel\";\n\nconst INDEX_VERSION = 1;\n\n/**\n * Holds the current instance of the `EventIndex` to use across the codebase.\n * Looking for an `EventIndex`? Just look for the `EventIndexPeg` on the peg\n * board. \"Peg\" is the literal meaning of something you hang something on. So\n * you'll find a `EventIndex` hanging on the `EventIndexPeg`.\n */\nexport class EventIndexPeg {\n    public index: EventIndex | null = null;\n    public error: unknown;\n\n    private _supportIsInstalled = false;\n\n    /**\n     * Initialize the EventIndexPeg and if event indexing is enabled initialize\n     * the event index.\n     *\n     * @return {Promise<boolean>} A promise that will resolve to true if an\n     * EventIndex was successfully initialized, false otherwise.\n     */\n    public async init(): Promise<boolean> {\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        if (!indexManager) {\n            logger.log(\"EventIndex: Platform doesn't support event indexing, not initializing.\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        this._supportIsInstalled = await indexManager.supportsEventIndexing();\n\n        if (!this.supportIsInstalled()) {\n            logger.log(\"EventIndex: Event indexing isn't installed for the platform, not initializing.\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        if (!SettingsStore.getValueAt(SettingLevel.DEVICE, \"enableEventIndexing\")) {\n            logger.log(\"EventIndex: Event indexing is disabled, not initializing\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return this.initEventIndex();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Initialize the event index.\n     *\n     * @returns {boolean} True if the event index was successfully initialized,\n     * false otherwise.\n     */\n    public async initEventIndex(): Promise<boolean> {\n        const index = new EventIndex();\n        const indexManager = PlatformPeg.get()?.getEventIndexingManager();\n        const client = MatrixClientPeg.get();\n        if (!indexManager || !client) {\n            throw new Error(\"Unable to init event index\");\n        }\n\n        const userId = client.getUserId()!;\n        const deviceId = client.getDeviceId()!;\n\n        try {\n            await indexManager.initEventIndex(userId, deviceId);\n\n            const userVersion = await indexManager.getUserVersion();\n            const eventIndexIsEmpty = await indexManager.isEventIndexEmpty();\n\n            if (eventIndexIsEmpty) {\n                await indexManager.setUserVersion(INDEX_VERSION);\n            } else if (userVersion === 0 && !eventIndexIsEmpty) {\n                await indexManager.closeEventIndex();\n                await this.deleteEventIndex();\n\n                await indexManager.initEventIndex(userId, deviceId);\n [...myReactions.values()];\n    }\n\n    private onShowAllClick = (): void => {\n        this.setState({\n            showAll: true,\n        });\n    };\n\n    public render(): React.ReactNode {\n Babel 7 supports this natively in their class handling.\nclass AbortLoginAndRebuildStorage extends Error {}\n\nasync function persistCredentials(credentials: IMatrixClientCreds): Promise<void> {\n    localStorage.setItem(HOMESERVER_URL_KEY, credentials.homeserverUrl);\n    if (credentials.identityServerUrl) {\n        localStorage.setItem(ID_SERVER_URL_KEY, credentials.identityServerUrl);\n    }\n    localStorage.setItem(\"mx_user_id\", credentials.userId);\n    localStorage.setItem(\"mx_is_guest\", JSON.stringify(credentials.guest));\n\n    await persistAccessTokenInStorage(credentials.accessToken, credentials.pickleKey);\n    await persistRefreshTokenInStorage(credentials.refreshToken, credentials.pickleKey);\n\n    if (credentials.pickleKey) {\n        localStorage.setItem(\"mx_has_pickle_key\", String(true));\n    } else {\n        if (localStorage.getItem(\"mx_has_pickle_key\") === \"true\") {\n            logger.error(\"Expected a pickle key, but none provided. If omitted, it\n     * defaults to 0.\n     */\n    public scrollToEvent(eventId: string, pixelOffset?: number, offsetBase?: number): void {\n        this.scrollPanel.current?.scrollToToken(eventId, pixelOffset, offsetBase);\n    }\n\n    public scrollToEventIfNeeded(eventId: string): void {\n        const node = this.getNodeForEventId(eventId);\n        if (node) {\n            node.scrollIntoView({\n                block: \"nearest\",\n                behavior: \"instant\",\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    private isUnmounting = (): boolean => {\n        return this.unmounted;\n    };\n\n    public get showHiddenEvents(): boolean {\n        return this.context?.showHiddenEvents ?? this._showHiddenEvents;\n    }\n\n    // TODO: Implement granular (per-room) hide options\n    public shouldShowEvent(mxEv: MatrixEvent, forceHideEvents = false): boolean {\n        if (this.props.hideThreadedMessages && this.props.room) {\n            const { shouldLiveInRoom } = this.props.room.eventShouldLiveIn(mxEv, this.props.events);\n            if (!shouldLiveInRoom) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (MatrixClientPeg.safeGet().isUserIgnored(mxEv.getSender()!)) {\n            return false; // ignored = no show (only happens if the ignore happens after an event was received)\n        }\n\n        if (this.showHiddenEvents && !forceHideEvents) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        if (!haveRendererForEvent(mxEv, MatrixClientPeg.safeGet(), this.showHiddenEvents)) {\n            return false; // no tile = no show\n        }\n\n        // Always show highlighted event\n        if (this.props.highlightedEventId === mxEv.getId()) return true;\n\n        return !shouldHideEvent(mxEv, this.context);\n    }\n\n    public readMarkerForEvent(eventId: string, isLastEvent: boolean): ReactNode {\n        if (this.context.timelineRenderingType === TimelineRenderingType.File) return null;\n\n        const visible = !isLastEvent && this.props.readMarkerVisible;\n\n        if (this.props.readMarkerEventId === eventId) {\n            let hr;\n            // if the read marker comes at the end of the timeline (except\n            // for local echoes, which are excluded from RMs, because they\n            // don't have useful event ids), we don't want to show it, but\n            // we still want to create the <li/> for it so that the\n            // algorithms which depend on its position on the screen aren't\n            // confused.\n            if (visible) {\n                hr = <hr style={{ opacity: 1, width: \"99%\" }} />;\n            }\n\n            return (\n                <li\n                    key={\"readMarker_\" + eventId}\n                    ref={this.readMarkerNode}\n                    className=\"mx_MessagePanel_myReadMarker\"\n                    data-scroll-tokens={eventId}\n                >\n                    {hr}\n                </li>\n            );\n        } else if (this.state.ghostReadMarkers.includes(eventId)) {\n            // We render 'ghost' read markers in the DOM while they\n            // transition away. This allows the actual read marker\n            // to be in the right place straight away without having\n            // to wait for the transition to finish.\n            // There are probably much simpler ways to do this transition,\n            // possibly using react-transition-group which handles keeping\n            // elements in the DOM whilst they transition out, although our\n            // case is a little more complex because only some of the items\n            // transition (ie. the read markers do but the event tiles do not)\n            // and TransitionGroup requires that all its children are Transitions.\n            const hr = (\n                <hr\n                    ref={this.collectGhostReadMarker}\n                    onTransitionEnd={this.onGhostTransitionEnd}\n                    data-eventid={eventId}\n                />\n            );\n\n            // give it a key which depends on the event id. That will ensure that\n            // we get a new DOM node (restarting the animation) when the ghost\n            // moves to a different event.\n            return (\n                <li key={\"_readuptoghost_\" + eventId} className=\"mx_MessagePanel_myReadMarker\">\n                    {hr}\n                </li>\n            );\n        }\n\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private collectGhostReadMarker = (node: HTMLElement | null): void => {\n        if (node) {\n            // now the element has appeared, change the style which will trigger the CSS transition\n            requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n                node.style.width = \"10%\";\n                node.style.opacity = \"0\";\n            });\n        }\n    };\n\n    private onGhostTransitionEnd = (ev: TransitionEvent): void => {\n        // we can now clean up the ghost element\n        const finishedEventId = (ev.target as HTMLElement).dataset.eventid;\n        this.setState({\n            ghostReadMarkers: this.state.ghostReadMarkers.filter((eid) => eid !== finishedEventId),\n        });\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Find the next event in the list, and the next visible event in the list.\n     *\n     * @param events     - the list of events to look in and whether they are shown\n     * @param i          - where in the list we are now\n     *\n     * @returns { nextEvent, nextTile }\n     *\n     * nextEvent is the event after i in the supplied array.\n     *\n     * nextTile is the first event in the array after i that we will show a tile\n     * for. It is used to to determine the 'last successful' flag when rendering\n     * the tile.\n     */\n    private getNextEventInfo(\n        events: WrappedEvent[],\n        i: number,\n    ): { nextEventAndShouldShow: WrappedEvent | null; nextTile: MatrixEvent | null } {\n        // WARNING: this method is on a hot path.\n\n        const nextEventAndShouldShow = i < events.length - 1 ? events[i + 1] : null;\n\n        const nextTile = findFirstShownAfter(i, events);\n\n        return { nextEventAndShouldShow, nextTile };\n    }\n\n    private get pendingEditItem(): string | null {\n        if (!this.props.room) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        try {\n            return localStorage.getItem(editorRoomKey(this.props.room.roomId, this.context.timelineRenderingType));\n        } catch (err) {\n            logger.error(err);\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private isSentState(ev: MatrixEvent): boolean {\n        const status = ev.getAssociatedStatus();\n        // A falsey state applies to events which have come down sync, including remote echoes\n        return !status || status === EventStatus.SENT;\n    }\n\n    private getEventTiles(): ReactNode[] {\n        // first figure out which is the last event in the list which we're\n        // actually going to show; this allows us to behave slightly\n        // differently for the last event in the list. // break on first grouper\n                }\n            }\n\n            if (!grouper) {\n                if (shouldShow) {\n                    // make sure we unpack the array returned by getTilesForEvent,\n                    // otherwise React will auto-generate keys, and we will end up\n                    // replacing all the DOM elements every time we paginate.\n                    ret.push(\n                        ...this.getTilesForEvent(\n                            prevEvent,\n                            wrappedEvent,\n                            last,\n                            false,\n                            nextEventAndShouldShow,\n                            nextTile,\n                        ),\n                    );\n                    prevEvent = event;\n                }\n\n                const readMarker = this.readMarkerForEvent(eventId, i >= lastShownNonLocalEchoIndex);\n                if (readMarker) ret.push(readMarker);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (grouper) {\n            ret.push(...grouper.getTiles());\n        }\n\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    public getTilesForEvent(\n        prevEvent: MatrixEvent | null,\n        wrappedEvent: WrappedEvent,\n        last = false,\n        isGrouped = false,\n        nextEvent: WrappedEvent | null = null,\n        nextEventWithTile: MatrixEvent | null = null,\n    ): ReactNode[] {\n        const mxEv = wrappedEvent.event;\n        const ret: ReactNode[] = [];\n\n        const isEditing = this.props.editState?.getEvent().getId() === mxEv.getId();\n        // local echoes have a fake date, which could even be yesterday. Treat them as 'today' for the date separators.\n        const ts1 = mxEv.getTs() ?? Date.now();\n\n        // do we need a separator since the last event?\n        const wantsSeparator = this.wantsSeparator(prevEvent, mxEv);\n        if (!isGrouped && this.props.room) {\n            if (wantsSeparator === SeparatorKind.Date) {\n                ret.push(\n                    <li key={ts1}>\n                        <DateSeparator key={ts1} roomId={this.props.room.roomId} ts={ts1} />\n                    </li>,\n                );\n            } else if (wantsSeparator === SeparatorKind.LateEvent) {\n                const text = _t(\"timeline|late_event_separator\", {\n label={text}>\n                            {text}\n                        </TimelineSeparator>\n                    </li>,\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        const cli = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        let lastInSection = true;\n        if (nextEventWithTile) {\n            const nextEv = nextEventWithTile;\n            const willWantSeparator = this.wantsSeparator(mxEv, nextEv);\n            lastInSection =\n                willWantSeparator === SeparatorKind.Date ||\n                mxEv.getSender() !== nextEv.getSender() ||\n ref={this.collectEventTile.bind(this, eventId)}\n                alwaysShowTimestamps={this.props.alwaysShowTimestamps}\n                mxEvent={mxEv}\n                continuation={continuation}\n resizeObserver={this.resizeObserver}\n                readReceipts={readReceipts}\n                readReceiptMap={this.readReceiptMap}\n                showUrlPreview={this.props.showUrlPreview}\n                checkUnmounting={this.isUnmounting}\n                eventSendStatus={mxEv.getAssociatedStatus() ?? undefined}\n                isTwelveHour={this.props.isTwelveHour}\n                permalinkCreator={this.props.permalinkCreator}\n                last={last}\n                lastInSection={lastInSection}\n                lastSuccessful={wrappedEvent.lastSuccessfulWeSent}\n                isSelectedEvent={highlight}\n                getRelationsForEvent={this.props.getRelationsForEvent}\n                showReactions={this.props.showReactions}\n                layout={this.props.layout}\n                showReadReceipts={this.props.showReadReceipts}\n                callEventGrouper={callEventGrouper}\n                hideSender={this.state.hideSender}\n            />,\n        );\n\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    public wantsSeparator(prevEvent: MatrixEvent | null, mxEvent: MatrixEvent): SeparatorKind {\n        if (this.context.timelineRenderingType SeparatorKind.LateEvent : SeparatorKind.Date;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // first event in the panel: depends on if we could back-paginate from here.\n        if (prevEvent === null && !this.props.canBackPaginate) {\n            return SeparatorKind.Date;\n        }\n\n        const nextEventDate = mxEvent.getDate() ?? new Date();\n        if (prevEvent !== null && wantsDateSeparator(prevEvent.getDate() || undefined, nextEventDate)) {\n            return SeparatorKind.Date;\n        }\n\n        return SeparatorKind.None;\n    }\n\n    // Get a list of read receipts that should be shown next to this event\n    // Receipts are objects which have a 'userId', 'roomMember' and 'ts'.\n    private getReadReceiptsForEvent(event: MatrixEvent): IReadReceiptProps[] | null {\n        const myUserId = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet().credentials.userId;\n\n        // get list of read receipts, sorted most recent first\n        const { room } = this.props;\n        if (!room) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        const receiptDestination = this.context.threadId ? room.getThread(this.context.threadId) : room;\n\n        const receipts: IReadReceiptProps[] = [];\n\n        if (!receiptDestination) {\n            logger.debug(\n                \"Discarding request, could not find the receiptDestination for event: \" + this.context.threadId,\n            );\n            return receipts;\n        }\n\n        receiptDestination.getReceiptsForEvent(event).forEach((r) => {\n            if (!r.userId || !isSupportedReceiptType(r.type) || r.userId === myUserId) {\n                return; // ignore non-read receipts and receipts from self.\n            }\n            if (MatrixClientPeg.safeGet().isUserIgnored(r.userId)) {\n                return; // ignore ignored users\n            }\n            const member = room.getMember(r.userId);\n            receipts.push({\n                userId: r.userId,\n                roomMember: member,\n                ts: r.data ? r.data.ts : 0,\n            });\n        });\n        return receipts;\n    }\n\n    // Get an object that maps from event ID to a list of read receipts that\n    // should be shown next to that event. If a hidden event has read receipts,\n    // they are folded into the receipts of the last shown event.\n    private getReadReceiptsByShownEvent(events: WrappedEvent[]): Map<string, IReadReceiptProps[]> {\n        const receiptsByEvent: Map<string, IReadReceiptProps[]> = new Map();\n        const receiptsByUserId: Map<string, IReadReceiptForUser> = new Map();\n\n        let lastShownEventId: string | undefined;\n        for (const event of this.props.events) {\n            if (this.shouldShowEvent(event)) {\n                lastShownEventId = event.getId();\n            }\n            if (!lastShownEventId) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            const existingReceipts = receiptsByEvent.get(lastShownEventId) || [];\n            const newReceipts = this.getReadReceiptsForEvent(event);\n            if (!newReceipts) continue;\n            receiptsByEvent.set(lastShownEventId, existingReceipts.concat(newReceipts));\n\n            // Record these receipts along with their last shown event ID for\n            // each associated user ID.\n            for (const receipt of newReceipts) {\n                receiptsByUserId.set(receipt.userId, {\n                    lastShownEventId,\n                    receipt,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // It's possible in some cases (for example, when a read receipt\n        // advances before we have paginated in the new event that it's marking\n        // received) that we can temporarily not have a matching event for\n        // someone which had one in the last. for (const userId of this.readReceiptsByUserId.keys()) {\n            if (receiptsByUserId.get(userId)) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            const { lastShownEventId, receipt } = this.readReceiptsByUserId.get(userId)!;\n            const existingReceipts = receiptsByEvent.get(lastShownEventId) || [];\n            receiptsByEvent.set(lastShownEventId,        return r2.ts - r1.ts;\n            });\n        }\n\n        return receiptsByEvent;\n    }\n\n    private collectEventTile = (eventId: string, node: UnwrappedEventTile): void => {\n        this.eventTiles[eventId] = node;\n    };\n\n    // Once dynamic content in the events load, make the scrollPanel check the scroll offsets.\n    public onHeightChanged = (): void => {\n        this.scrollPanel.current?.checkScroll();\n    };\n\n    private resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(this.onHeightChanged);\n\n    private onTypingShown = (): void => {\n        const scrollPanel = this.scrollPanel.current;\n        // this will make the timeline grow, so checkScroll\n        scrollPanel?.checkScroll();\n        if (scrollPanel && scrollPanel.getScrollState().stuckAtBottom) {\n            scrollPanel.preventShrinking();\n        }\n    };\n\n    private onTypingHidden = (): void => {\n        const scrollPanel = this.scrollPanel.current;\n        if (scrollPanel) {\n scrollPanel.updatePreventShrinking();\n            // order is important here as checkScroll will scroll down to\n            // reveal added padding to balance the notifs disappearing.\n            scrollPanel.checkScroll();\n        }\n    };\n\n    public updateTimelineMinHeight(): void {\n        const scrollPanel = this.scrollPanel.current;\n\n        if (scrollPanel) {\n            const this.scrollPanel.current;\n        if (scrollPanel) {\n            scrollPanel.clearPreventShrinking();\n        }\n    }\n\n    public render(): React.ReactNode {\n        let topSpinner;\n        let bottomSpinner;\n        if (this.props.backPaginating) {\n            topSpinner = (\n                <li key=\"_topSpinner\">\n                    <Spinner />\n                </li>\n            );\n        }\n        if (this.props.forwardPaginating) {\n            bottomSpinner = (\n                <li key=\"_bottomSpinner\">\n                    <Spinner />\n                </li>\n            );\n        }\n\n        const style = this.props.hidden ? { display: \"none\" } : {};\n\n        let whoIsTyping;\n        if (\n            this.props.room &&\n            this.state.showTypingNotifications &&\n            this.context.timelineRenderingType === TimelineRenderingType.Room\n        ) {\n            whoIsTyping = (\n                <WhoIsTypingTile\n </ErrorBoundary>\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Holds on to an event, caching the information about it in the context of the current messages list.\n * Avoids calling shouldShowEvent more times than Do not show jump bar if neither the RM nor the RR are set.\n        // 3. We want to show the bar if the read-marker is off the top of the screen.\n        // 4. Also, if pos === null, the event might not be paginated - show the unread bar\n        const pos = this.getReadMarkerPosition();\n        const ret =\n            this.state.readMarkerEventId !== null && // 1.\n            (pos === null || pos < 0); // 3., 4.\n        return ret;\n    };\n\n    /*\n     * called by the parent component when PageUp/Down/etc is pressed.\n     *\n     * We pass it down to the scroll panel.\n     */\n    public handleScrollKey = (ev: React.KeyboardEvent | KeyboardEvent): void => {\n        if (!this.messagePanel.current) return;\n\n        // jump to the live timeline on ctrl-end, rather than the end of the\n        // timeline window.\n        const action = getKeyBindingsManager().getRoomAction(ev);\n        if (action === KeyBindingAction.JumpToLatestMessage) {\n            this.jumpToLiveTimeline();\n        } else {\n            this.messagePanel.current.handleScrollKey(ev);\n        }\n    };\n\n    private initTimeline(props: IProps): void {\n        const initialEvent = props.eventId;\n        const pixelOffset = props.eventPixelOffset;\n\n        // if a pixelOffset is given, it is relative to the bottom of the\n        // container. If not, put the event in the middle of the container.\n        let offsetBase = 1;\n        if (pixelOffset == null) {\n            offsetBase = 0.5;\n        }\n\n        return this.loadTimeline(initialEvent, pixelOffset, offsetBase, props.eventScrollIntoView);\n    }\n\n    private scrollIntoView(eventId?: string, pixelOffset?: number, offsetBase?: number): void {\n        const doScroll = (): void => {\n            if (!this.messagePanel.current) return;\n            if (eventId) {\n                debuglog(\n                    \"TimelinePanel scrolling to eventId \" +\n                        eventId +\n                        \" at position \" +\n                        offsetBase! * 100 +\n                        \"% + \" +\n                        pixelOffset,\n                );\n                this.messagePanel.current.scrollToEvent(eventId, pixelOffset, offsetBase);\n            } else {\n                debuglog(\"TimelinePanel scrolling to bottom\");\n                this.messagePanel.current.scrollToBottom();\n            }\n        };\n\n        debuglog(\"TimelinePanel scheduling scroll to event\");\n        this.props.onEventScrolledIntoView?.(eventId);\n        // Ensure the correct scroll position pre render, if the messages have already been loaded to DOM,\n        // to avoid it jumping around\n        doScroll();\n\n        // Ensure the correct scroll position post render for correct behaviour.\n        //\n        // requestAnimationFrame runs our code immediately after the DOM update but before the next repaint.\n        //\n        // If the messages have just been loaded for the first time, this ensures we'll repeat setting the\n        // correct scroll position after React has re-rendered the TimelinePanel and MessagePanel and\n        // updated the DOM.\n        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n            doScroll();\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * (re)-load the event timeline, and initialise the scroll state, centered\n     * around the given event.\n     *\n     * @param {string?}  eventId the event to focus on. this.props.timelineSet.relations?.getChildEventsForEvent(eventId, relationType, eventType);\n\n    private buildLegacyCallEventGroupers(events?: MatrixEvent[]): void {\n        this.callEventGroupers UI URL. The following API is exposed:\n{\n    action: \"invite\" | \"membership_state\" | \"bot_options\" | \"set_bot_options\" | etc... ,\n    room_id: $ROOM_ID,\n    user_id: $USER_ID\n    // additional request fields\n}\n\nThe complete request object is returned to the caller with an additional \"response\" key like so:\n{\n    action: \"invite\" | \"membership_state\" | \"bot_options\" | \"set_bot_options\",\n    room_id: $ROOM_ID,\n    user_id: $USER_ID,\n    // additional request fields\n    response: { ... }\n}\n\nThe \"action\" determines the format of the request and response. All actions can return an error response.\nAn error response is a \"response\" object which consists of a sole \"error\" key to indicate an error.\nThey look like:\n{\n    error: {\n        message: \"Unable to invite user into room.\",\n        _error: <Original Error Object>\n    }\n}\nThe \"message\" key should be a human-friendly string.\n\nACTIONS\n=======\nAll actions can return an error response instead of the response outlined below.\n\ninvite\n------\nInvites a user into a room. The request will no-op if the user is already joined OR invited to the room.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room to invite the user into.\n - user_id is the user ID to invite.\n - No additional fields.\nResponse:\n{\n    success: true\n}\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"invite\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    user_id: \"@invitee:bar\",\n    response: {\n        success: true\n    }\n}\n\nkick\n------\nKicks a user from a room. The request will no-op if the user is not in the room.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room to kick the user from.\n - user_id is the user ID to kick.\n - reason is an optional string for the kick reason\nResponse:\n{\n    success: true\n}\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"kick\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    user_id: \"@target:example.org\",\n    reason: \"Removed from room\",\n    response: {\n        success: true\n    }\n}\n\nset_bot_options\n---------------\nSet the m.room.bot.options state event for a bot user.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room to send the state event into.\n - user_id is the user ID of the bot who you're setting options for.\n - \"content\" is an object consisting of the content you wish to set.\nResponse:\n{\n    success: true\n}\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"set_bot_options\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    user_id: \"@bot:bar\",\n    content: {\n        default_option: \"alpha\"\n    },\n    response: {\n        success: true\n    }\n}\n\nget_membership_count\n--------------------\nGet the number of joined users in the room.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room to get the count in.\nResponse:\n78\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"get_membership_count\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    response: 78\n}\n\ncan_send_event\n--------------\nCheck if the client can send the given event into the given room. If the client\nis unable to do this, an error response is returned instead of 'response: false'.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room to do the check in.\n - event_type is the event type which will be sent.\n - is_state is true if the event to be sent is a state event.\nResponse:\ntrue\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"can_send_event\",\n    is_state: false,\n    event_type: \"m.room.message\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    response: true\n}\n\nset_widget\n----------\nSet a new widget in the room. Clobbers based on the ID.\n\nRequest:\n - `room_id` (String) is the room to set the widget in.\n - `widget_id` (String) is the ID of the widget to add (or replace if it already exists).\n   It can be an arbitrary UTF8 string and is purely for distinguishing between widgets.\n - `url` (String) is the URL that clients should load in an iframe to run the widget.\n   All widgets must have a valid URL. If the URL is `null` (not `undefined`), the\n   widget will be removed from the room.\n - `type` (String) is the type of widget, which is provided as a hint for matrix clients so they\n   can configure/lay out the widget in different ways. All widgets must have a type.\n - `name` (String) is an optional human-readable string about the widget.\n - `data` (Object) is some optional data about the widget, and can contain arbitrary key/value pairs.\n - `avatar_url` (String) is some optional mxc: URI pointing to the avatar of the widget.\nResponse:\n{\n    success: true\n}\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"set_widget\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    widget_id: \"abc123\",\n    url: \"http://widget.url\",\n    type: \"example\",\n    response: {\n        success: true\n    }\n}\n\nget_widgets\n-----------\nGet a list of all widgets in the room. The response is an array\nof state events.\n\nRequest:\n - `room_id` (String) is the room to get the widgets in.\nResponse:\n[\n    {\n        // TODO: Enable support for m.widget event type (https://github.com/vector-im/element-web/issues/13111)\n        type: \"im.vector.modular.widgets\",\n        state_key: \"wid1\",\n        content: {\n            type: \"grafana\",\n            url: \"https://grafanaurl\",\n            name: \"dashboard\",\n            data: {key: \"val\"}\n        }\n        room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n        sender: \"@alice:localhost\"\n    }\n]\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"get_widgets\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    response: [\n        {\n            // TODO: Enable support for m.widget event type (https://github.com/vector-im/element-web/issues/13111)\n            type: \"im.vector.modular.widgets\",\n            state_key: \"wid1\",\n            content: {\n                type: \"grafana\",\n                url: \"https://grafanaurl\",\n                name: \"dashboard\",\n                data: {key: \"val\"}\n            }\n            room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n            sender: \"@alice:localhost\"\n        }\n    ]\n}\n\nmembership_state AND bot_options\n--------------------------------\nGet the content of the \"m.room.member\" or \"m.room.bot.options\" state event respectively.\n\nNB: Whilst this API is basically equivalent to getStateEvent, we specifically do not\n    want external entities to be able to query any state event for any room, hence the\n    restrictive API outlined here.\n\nRequest:\n - room_id is the room which has the state event.\n - user_id is the state_key parameter which in both cases is a user ID (the member or the bot).\n - No additional fields.\nResponse:\n - The event content. If there is no state event, the \"response\" key should be null.\nExample:\n{\n    action: \"membership_state\",\n    room_id: \"!foo:bar\",\n    user_id: \"@somemember:bar\",\n    response: {\n        membership: \"join\",\n        displayname: \"Bob\",\n        avatar_url: null\n    }\n}\n\nget_open_id_token\n-----------------\nGet an openID token for the current user session.\nRequest: No parameters\nResponse:\n - The openId token object as described in https://spec.matrix.org/v1.2/client-server-api/#post_matrixclientv3useruseridopenidrequest_token\n\nsend_event\n----------\nSends an event in a room.\n\nRequest:\n - type is the event type to send.\n - state_key is the state key to send. Omitted if not a state event.\n - content is the event content to send.\n\nResponse:\n - room_id is the room ID where the event was sent.\n - event_id is the event ID of the event which was sent.\n\nread_events\n-----------\nRead events from a room.\n\nRequest:\n - type is the event type to read.\n - state_key is the state key to read, or `true` to read all events of the type.  // This is the horizontal one, changing the distribution of the width between the app tiles\n        // (ie. a vertical resize handle because, the handle itself is vertical...)\n        const });\n            },\n            onResizeStop: () => {\n                this.resizeContainer?.classList.remove(\"mx_AppsDrawer--resizing\");\n         );\n            } catch (e) {\n                console.warn(\"Failed to detect default locale\", e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        this.defaultCountry = defaultCountry ?? this.countries[0];\n        this.state = {\n            searchQuery: \"\",\n        };\n    }\n\n    public componentDidMount(): void {\n        if (!this.props.value) {\n            // If no value is this.props.onOptionChange(this.defaultCountry);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private onSearchChange = (search: string): void => {\n        this.setState({\n            searchQuery: search,\n        });\n Label,\n    PasswordControl,\n    Root,\n    Text,\n} from \"@vector-im/compound-web\";\nimport CopyIcon from \"@vector-im/compound-design-tokens/assets/web/icons/copy\";\nimport KeyIcon from }\n        }\n\n        this.prevWindowWidth = UIStore.instance.windowWidth || 1000;\n\n        // object field used for tracking the status info appended to the title tag.\n        // we don't do it as react state as i'm scared about triggering needless react refreshes.\n        this.subTitleStatus = \"\";\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Kick off a call to {@link initSession}, and handle any errors\n     */\n    private startInitSession = (): void => {\n        const initProm = this.initSession();\n\n        initProm.catch((err) => {\n            // TODO: show an error screen, rather than a spinner of doom\n            logger.error(\"Error initialising Matrix session\", err);\n        });\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Do what we can to establish a Matrix session.\n     *\n     *  * Special-case soft-logged-out sessions\n     *  * If we have OIDC or token login parameters, follow them\n     *  * If we have a guest access token in the query params, use that\n     *  * If we have parameters in local storage, use them\n     *  * Attempt to auto-register as a guest\n     *  * If all else fails, present a login screen.\n     */\n    private async initSession(): Promise<void> {\n        // The Rust Crypto SDK will break if two Element instances try to use the same datastore at once, so\n        // make sure we are the only Element instance in town (on this browser/domain).\n        const platform = PlatformPeg.get();\n        if (platform && !(await platform.getSessionLock(() => this.onSessionLockStolen()))) {\n            // we failed to get the lock. onSessionLockStolen should already have been called, so nothing left to do.\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // If the user was soft-logged-out, we want to make the SoftLogout component responsible for doing any\n by special-casing soft-logged-out sessions.\n        if (Lifecycle.isSoftLogout()) {\n            // When the session loads it'll be detected as soft logged out and a dispatch\n            // will be sent out to say that, triggering this MatrixChat to show the soft\n            // logout page.\n            Lifecycle.loadSession({ abortSignal: this.loadSessionAbortController.signal });\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, the first thing to do is to try the token params in the query-string\n        const delegatedAuthSucceeded = await Lifecycle.attemptDelegatedAuthLogin(\n            this.props.realQueryParams,\n            this.props.defaultDeviceDisplayName,\n            this.getFragmentAfterLogin(),\n        );\n\n        // remove the loginToken or auth code from the URL regardless\n        if (\n            this.props.realQueryParams?.loginToken ||\n            this.props.realQueryParams?.code ||\n            this.props.realQueryParams?.state\n        ) {\n Time to fire up the client.\n            this.tokenLogin = true;\n\n            // Create and start the client\n            // accesses the new credentials just set in storage during attemptDelegatedAuthLogin\n            // and sets logged in state\n            await Lifecycle.restoreSessionFromStorage({ ignoreGuest: true });\n            await this.postLoginSetup();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // if the user has followed a login or register link, don't reanimate\n        // the old creds, but rather go straight to the relevant page\n        const firstScreen = this.screenAfterLogin ? this.screenAfterLogin.screen : null;\n        const restoreSuccess = await this.loadSession();\n        if (restoreSuccess) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // If the first screen is an auth screen, we don't want to wait for login.\n        if (firstScreen !== null && AUTH_SCREENS.includes(firstScreen)) {\n            this.showScreenAfterLogin();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private async onSessionLockStolen(): Promise<void> {\n        // switch to the LockStolenView. We deliberately do this immediately, rather than going through the dispatcher,\n        // because there can be a substantial queue in the dispatcher, and some of the events in it might require an\n        // active MatrixClient.\n        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\n            this.setState({ view: Views.LOCK_STOLEN }, resolve);\n        });\n\n        // now we can tell the Lifecycle routines to abort any active startup, and to stop the active client.\n        await Lifecycle.onSessionLockStolen();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Perform actions that are specific to a user that has just us that we successfully completed a non-OIDC login or\n     *    registration.\n     *\n     * In both cases, {@link Action.OnLoggedIn} will already have been emitted, but the call to {@link switches to {@link Views.E2E_SETUP} or\n     * {@link Views.COMPLETE_SECURITY}, which will later call {@link onCompleteSecurityE2eSetupFinished}.\n     */\n    private async postLoginSetup(): Promise<void> {\n        const cli = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        const cryptoEnabled = Boolean(cli.getCrypto());\n        if (!cryptoEnabled) {\n            this.onShowPostLoginScreen();\n        }\n\n        const promisesList: Promise<any>[] = [this.firstSyncPromise.promise];\n        let crossSigningIsSetUp = false;\n        if (cryptoEnabled) {\n            // check if the user has promisesList.push(\n                (async (): Promise<void> => {\n                    crossSigningIsSetUp = Boolean(await cli.getCrypto()?.userHasCrossSigningKeys());\n                })(),\n (crossSigningIsSetUp) {\n            // if the user has previously set up cross-signing, verify this device so we can fetch the\n            // private keys.\n\n            const cryptoExtension = this.setStateForNewView({ view: Views.E2E_SETUP });\n        } else {\n            this.onShowPostLoginScreen();\n        }\n        this.setState({ pendingInitialSync: false });\n    }\n\n    public setState<K extends keyof IState>(\n        state:\n            | ((prevState: Readonly<IState>, props: Readonly<IProps>) => Pick<IState, K> | IState | null)\n            | (Pick<IState, K> | IState | ${Views[state.view]}`);\n        }\n        if (this.shouldTrackPageChange(this.state, { ...this.state, ...state })) {\n            this.startPageChangeTimer();\n        }\n        super.setState<K>(state, callback);\n    }\n\n    public componentDidMount(): void {\n        UIStore.instance.on(UI_EVENTS.Resize, this.handleResize);\n\n        // For PersistentElement\n this.dispatcherRef = dis.register(this.onAction);\n\n        this.themeWatcher = new ThemeWatcher();\n        this.fontWatcher = new FontWatcher();\n        this.themeWatcher.start();\n        this.themeWatcher.on(ThemeWatcherEvent.Change, setTheme);\n        this.fontWatcher.start();\n\n        initSentry(SdkConfig.get(\"sentry\"));\n        window.addEventListener(\"resize\", `font-size:${normalFontSize};`,\n        );\n    }, 1000);\n\n    private getFallbackHsUrl(): string | undefined {\n        if (this.getServerProperties().serverConfig?.isDefault) {\n     if (!loadedSession) {\n                    // fall back to showing the welcome screen... unless we have a 3pid invite pending\n                    if (\n undefined;\n    }\n\n    private setStateForNewView(state: Partial<IState>): void {\n        if (state.view === undefined) {\n            throw new Error(\"setStateForNewView with no view!\");\n        }\n        this.setState({\n            currentUserId: undefined,\n            justRegistered: false,\n            ...state,\n        } as IState);\n    }\n\n    private onAction = (payload:  // If we are redirecting to a Room Alias and it is for the room we already showing then replace history item\n        let replaceLast = presentedId[0] === \"#\" && roomInfo.room_id === this.state.forceTimeline;\n            roomInfo.justCreatedOpts = roomInfo.justCreatedOpts ?? this.state.roomJustCreatedOpts;\n        }\n\n        if (roomInfo.event_id && roomInfo.highlighted) {\n roomInfo.forceTimeline,\n                ready: true,\n                roomJustCreatedOpts: roomInfo.justCreatedOpts,\n            },\n            () => {\n                this.notifyNewScreen(\"room/\" + presentedId, replaceLast);\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    private viewSomethingBehindModal(): void {\n        if (this.state.view !== Views.LOGGED_IN) {\n            this.viewWelcome();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (!this.state.currentRoomId && !this.state.currentUserId && !this.isLoggedInViewPageDisplayed()) {\n            this.viewHome();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private viewWelcome(): void {\n        if (shouldUseLoginForWelcome(SdkConfig.get())) {\n            return this.viewLogin();\n        }\n this.setStateForNewView({\n            view: Views.LOGIN,\n            ...otherState,\n        });\n        this.notifyNewScreen(\"login\");\n    }\n\n    private viewHome(justRegistered = false): currentRoomId: null,\n        });\n        this.setPage(PageType.HomePage);\n        this.notifyNewScreen(\"home\");\n    }\n\n    private viewUser(userId: string, subAction: string): void {\n (shouldCreate) {\n            createRoom(MatrixClientPeg.safeGet(), opts!);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private chatCreateOrReuse(userId: string): void {\n        // Use a deferred action to reshow the  </strong>,\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        return warnings;\n    }\n\n    private leaveRoom(roomId: string): void {\n        const cli = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n _t(\"error_dialog|copy_room_link_failed|description\"),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Returns true if the user must go through the device verification process before they\n     * can use the app.\n     * @returns true if the user must verify\n     */\n    private async shouldForceVerification(): Promise<boolean> {\n        if (!SdkConfig.get(\"force_verification\")) return   /**\n     * Show the first screen after the application is successfully loaded in a logged-in state.\n     *\n     * Called:\n     *\n     *  - on {@link Action.OnLoggedIn}, but only when we don't else if (MatrixClientPeg.currentUserIsJustRegistered()) {\n            MatrixClientPeg.setJustRegisteredUserId(null);\n\n            if (ThreepidInviteStore.instance.pickBestInvite()) {\n       showAnalyticsToast();\n                } else {\n                    // It's possible for the value to change if a cached sync loads at page load, but then network\n                    // sync this.screenAfterLogin = undefined;\n        } else if (localStorage && localStorage.getItem(\"mx_last_room_id\")) {\n            // Before defaulting to directory, show the last viewed room\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Handle an {@link Action.OnLoggedIn} action (i.e, we now have a client with working credentials).\n     */\n    private onLoggedIn(): void {\n        this.stores.client = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n        StorageManager.tryPersistStorage();\n\n        // If we're loading the app for the first time, we can now transition to a splash screen while we wait for the\n        // client to start. The exceptions are:\n        //\n        //   - If there is a token login in flight: in that case we wait for the login to complete (which hits\n        //     `postLoginSetup`).\n        //\n        //   - Lifecycle emits an `Action.OnLoggedIn` event during startup even if the localstorage flag indicating a\n        //     previous soft logout is set. In that situation we actually want to wait for the `Action.ClientNotViable`\n        //     event, which will transition us into Views.SOFT_LOGOUT. We therefore have to check for !isSoftLogout().\n        //     There will be a subsequent `Action.OnLoggedIn` event once the reauthentication completes.\n        //\n        //     XXX: fix this properly by having Lifecycle not emit OnLoggedIn when it knows it is about to emit a\n        //     ClientNotViable.\n        //\n        // If we're already in the SOFT_LOGOUT view, that means that reauthentication has succeeded, and we can\n        // transition to the splash screen.\n        if (\n            (this.state.view === Views.LOADING && !Lifecycle.isSoftLogout() && !this.tokenLogin) ||\n            this.state.view === Views.SOFT_LOGOUT\n        ) {\n            this.setStateForNewView({ view: Views.PENDING_CLIENT_START });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Called when the session is logged out\n     */\n    private onLoggedOut(): void {\n        this.viewLogin({\n            ready: false,\n            collapseLhs: false,\n            currentRoomId: null,\n        });\n false,\n            currentRoomId: null,\n        });\n        this.subTitleStatus = \"\";\n        this.setPageSubtitle();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Called just before the matrix client is started\n     * (useful for setting listeners)\n     */\n    private onWillStartClient(): void {\n        // Reset the 'have completed first sync' flag,\n        // since we're about to start the client and therefore about to do the first sync\n        // We resolve the existing promise with the new one to update any existing listeners\n        if (!this.firstSyncComplete) {\n            const firstSyncPromise = Promise.withResolvers<void>();\n            this.firstSyncPromise.resolve(firstSyncPromise.promise);\n            this.firstSyncPromise = firstSyncPromise;\n        } else {\n            this.firstSyncPromise = Promise.withResolvers();\n        }\n        this.firstSyncComplete = false;\n        const cli = MatrixClientPeg.safeGet();\n\n        // Allow the JS SDK to reap timeline events. This reduces the amount of\n        // memory consumed as the JS SDK stores multiple distinct copies of room\n        // state (each of which can be 10s of MBs) for each DISJOINT timeline. This is\n        // particularly noticeable when there are lots of 'limited' /sync responses\n        // such as when laptops unsleep.\n        // https://github.com/vector-im/element-web/issues/3307#issuecomment-282895568\n        cli.setCanResetTimelineCallback((roomId) => {\n            logger.log(\"Request to reset timeline in room \", roomId, \" viewing:\", this.state.currentRoomId);\n            if (roomId !== this.state.currentRoomId) {\n                // It is safe to remove events from rooms we are not viewing.\n                return true;\n            }\n            // We are viewing the room which we want to reset. It is only safe to do\n            // this if we are not scrolled up in the view. To find out, delegate to\n            // the timeline panel. If the timeline panel doesn't exist, then we assume\n            // it is safe to reset the timeline.\n            if (!this.loggedInView.current) {\n                return true;\n            }\n            return this.loggedInView.current.canResetTimelineInRoom(roomId);\n        });\n\n        cli.on(ClientEvent.Sync, (state: SyncState, prevState: SyncState | null, data?: SyncStateData) => {\n            if (state === SyncState.Error || state === SyncState.Reconnecting) {\n                this.setState({ syncError: data?.error ?? null });\n            } else if (this.state.syncError) {\n                this.setState({ syncError: null });\n            }\n\n            if (state === SyncState.Syncing && prevState === SyncState.Syncing) {\n                // We know we have performabed a live update and known rooms should be in a good state.\n                // Now is a good time to clean up drafts.\n                cleanUpDraftsIfRequired();\n                return;\n            }\n            logger.debug(`MatrixClient sync state => ${state}`);\n            if (state !== SyncState.Prepared) {\n                return;\n            }\n\n            this.firstSyncComplete = true;\n            this.firstSyncPromise.resolve();\n\n            if (Notifier.shouldShowPrompt() && !MatrixClientPeg.userRegisteredWithinLastHours(24)) {\n                showNotificationsToast(false);\n            }\n\n            dis.fire(Action.FocusSendMessageComposer);\n        });\n\n        cli.on(HttpApiEvent.SessionLoggedOut, (errObj) => {\n            this.loadSessionAbortController.abort(errObj);\n            this.loadSessionAbortController = new AbortController();\n\n            if (Lifecycle.isLoggingOut()) return;\n\n            // A modal might have been open when we were logged out by the server\n            Modal.forceCloseAllModals();\n\n            if (errObj.httpStatus === 401 && errObj.data?.[\"soft_logout\"]) {\n                logger.warn(\"Soft logout issued by server - avoiding data deletion\");\n                Lifecycle.softLogout();\n                return;\n            }\n\n            dis.dispatch(\n                {\n                    action: \"logout\",\n                },\n                true,\n            );\n\n            // The above dispatch closes all modals, so open the modal after calling it synchronously\n            Modal.createDialog(ErrorDialog, {\n                title: _t(\"auth|session_logged_out_title\"),\n                description: _t(\"auth|session_logged_out_description\"),\n            });\n        });\n        cli.on(HttpApiEvent.NoConsent, function (message, consentUri) {\n            const { finished } = Modal.createDialog(\n                QuestionDialog,\n                {\n                    title: _t(\"terms|tac_title\"),\n                    description: (\n                        <div>\n                            <p> {_t(\"terms|tac_description\", { homeserverDomain: cli.getDomain() })}</p>\n                        </div>\n                    ),\n                    button: _t(\"terms|tac_button\"),\n                    cancelButton: _t(\"action|dismiss\"),\n                },\n                undefined,\n                true,\n            );\n            finished.then(([confirmed]) => {\n                if (confirmed) {\n                    const wnd = window.open(consentUri, \"_blank\")!;\n                    wnd.opener = null;\n                }\n            });\n        });\n\n        DecryptionFailureTracker.instance\n            .start(cli)\n            .catch((e) => logger.error(\"Unable to start DecryptionFailureTracker\", e));\n\n        cli.on(ClientEvent.Room, (room) => {\n            if (cli.getCrypto()) {\n                const /*explicit=*/ true,\n                );\n                room.setBlacklistUnverifiedDevices(blacklistEnabled);\n            }\n        });\n        cli.on(CryptoEvent.KeyBackupFailed, async (errcode): cli.getCrypto() && (await cli.getCrypto()?.getActiveSessionBackupVersion()) !== null,\n            );\n\n            // if key backup is still enabled, there must be a new backup in place\n            if (keyBackupEnabled) {\n                haveNewVersion = true;\n            } else {\n                // otherwise check the server to see if there's a new one\n                try {\n
